A [[Human/Legends|Human]],<ref name="Logic" /> '''Davin''', trained as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy]] on<ref name="Twitteryea">{{Twitter|TK329|status/4101380740|TK329|quote=I finished top of my class from the Academy of Carida. Raithal gets the accolades but I would gladly challenge any of their graduates.|archivedate=20200813210718}}, establishing TK329, and thus Davin, trained at this Academy.</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].<ref name="Twitteryea" /> While training there, Davin and another cadet, later designated [[TK329]], became good friends. They parted<ref name="Tweet" /> in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]<ref name="OtherTweet">''[[Death Troopers]]'' places the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] outbreak on the Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']], during which TK329 was tweeting, in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. In [http://twitter.com/#!/TK329/status/4004290683 this tweet], TK329 stated he graduated three years previously.</ref> after their admittance into the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] because they were stationed at different locations.<ref name="Tweet" /> [[1 BBY/Legends|Three years later]],<ref name="OtherTweet" /> TK329 still considered Davin to be his closest friend, citing their relationship and history<ref name="Tweet" /> in a public broadcast from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']].<ref name="ContextTweet">{{Twitter|TK329|status/3980168845|TK329|quote=This is TK 329 of the Imperial Army, broadcasting from the Star Destroyer, Vector.|archivedate=20210704035515}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Davin was mentioned in a [[Wikipedia:Twitter|tweet]] from TK329's [[in-universe]] [[Stormtrooper TK 329 (TK329) on Twitter|Twitter account]] posted on [[September 20]], [[2009]].<ref name="Tweet" /> The account was created as a tie-in to the then-upcoming novel ''[[Death Troopers]]'' by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
